claim: Patchline ships a public, versioned API serving corpus-scale hazard statistics with rate-limited reproducibility. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the rate-limited claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make corpus-stats-public-api-gate`.
